author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
After pulling latest from [feenberg/taxsim](https://github.com/feenberg/taxsim), this appears to be fixed in commit `2c5d32e` ("rebate"). The updated `11ga.for` now has three separate rebate windows instead of one catch-all:

```fortran
if(law.ge.2020.and.statax.gt.0d0) then 
   reb=250d0*d(7)
   if(nfile.eq.3) reb=375d0
   rebate=twn(taxbc,0d0,reb)
   if(    in(law,2021,2022)) then
      rebate=rebatef(rebate,law,2021,2022)
   elseif(in(law,2022,2023)) then 
      rebate=rebatef(rebate,law,2022,2023)
   elseif(in(law,2023,2024)) then
      rebate=rebatef(rebate,law,2023,2024)
   else
      rebate=0d0
   endif
   statax=statax-rebate
endif
```

This also fixes the HoH amount (now correctly `375` instead of `250*d(7)`).

The compiled binary we were running was from the older source. Rebuilding from the latest source should resolve the 30 GA mismatches.
